name: hc-matrix-join-body
prompt: Bug: adding a Matrix integration fails against some homeservers. When the user adds a Matrix integration, Healthchecks asks the homeserver to join the room, and that join request is sent with no request body. The Matrix client-server API requires every such request to carry a JSON object as its body, even an empty one, and strict homeservers reject the request. Expected: the join request sends an empty JSON object as its body.
